title: Translation API Adapter
instructions: Complete `translation/adapters.py`. Declare the `TranslationAdapter` interface, then implement `MicrosoftTranslationAdapter` and `GoogleTranslationAdapter` by composition, keeping the vendor clients in `translate_api` and `google_translate_api`. The Google adapter must convert a `TranslationRequest` into a `GoogleTranslationRequest`. Do not edit the provided `services.py` or `model.py`.

evidence.label: TranslationAdapter declares exactly translate and get_supported_languages
Adapters implement the interface and wrap (not subclass) the vendor clients
Microsoft adapter unpacks the request into the vendor call
Google adapter converts to GoogleTranslationRequest before convert()
Google adapter forwards the confidence threshold
Supported languages come straight from each vendor
The caller's request is left unchanged
Client code can use both vendors through the interface
